scripts.devtest: UI_PORT=$(port) HC_APP_PORT=$(port) HC_ADMIN_PORT=$(port) HAPP_BUILD_MODE='Debug' concurrently "npm run start:happ" "sleep 5 && npm run start:ui"
scripts.devtest:block: UI_PORT=$(port) HC_APP_PORT=$(port) HC_ADMIN_PORT=$(port) HAPP_BUILD_MODE='Debug' APPLET_VIEW='ImportFile' concurrently "npm run start:happ" "npm run start:ui"
scripts.start:happ: RUST_LOG=warn WASM_LOG=debug echo "pass" | hc s --piped -f=$HC_ADMIN_PORT generate ../artifacts/files.happ --run=$HC_APP_PORT -a Files
scripts.start:happ:local: RUST_LOG=warn WASM_LOG=debug echo "pass" | hc s --piped -f=$HC_ADMIN_PORT generate ../artifacts/files.happ --run=$HC_APP_PORT -a Files network -b "http://127.0.0.1:$BOOT_PORT" quic "http://127.0.0.1:$BOOT_PORT/relay"
scripts.start:local: UI_PORT=$(port) HC_APP_PORT=$(port) HC_ADMIN_PORT=$(port) HAPP_BUILD_MODE='Debug' concurrently "npm run start:happ:local" "npm run start:ui"
scripts.network:local2: npm run build &&  BOOT_PORT=$(port) concurrently "npm run serve:run" "npm run start:local" "sleep 1 && npm run start:local"
